introHtml: Classic C handle mugs are a staple in any office breakroom, but standard mugs can crack or become too hot to handle when microwaved. Our microwave safe versions are made from high-quality ceramic that heats evenly and stays cool to the touch on the handle. Ideal for corporate cafeterias or employee gifts, these mugs can be decorated with your logo using full-color imprint or classic engraving. Choose from popular sizes like 11 oz or 15 oz to match your team's coffee habits.
heroAltText: Custom microwave safe classic c handle mugs with ceramic construction and comfortable handle, ideal for hot beverages.
